## Fixture sets

## Outcomes and evidence

| Expected outcome | Fixtures |
| --- | --- |
| `must-flag` | 2,417 |
| `must-not-flag` | 3,486 |
| `not-assertable` | 47 |

Outcome comes from the legacy assessment kind and, for `policy`, from whether the fixture has expected spans. The basis comes from the tier (T1 `provider-documented`, T2 `tool-corroborated`, T3 `project-policy`, T0 `unresolved`) with the same mechanical tightening as the taxonomy import; it is carried by each fixture's evidence entry, never by an id.

| Legacy kind / tier | Canonical outcome | Fixtures |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `must-not-flag/T0` | `not-assertable` | 19 |
| `must-not-flag/T1` | `must-not-flag` | 10 |
| `must-not-flag/T2` | `must-not-flag` | 2,069 |
| `must-not-flag/T3` | `must-not-flag` | 1,407 |
| `must-redact/T0` | `not-assertable` | 28 |
| `must-redact/T1` | `must-flag` | 1,298 |
| `must-redact/T2` | `must-flag` | 551 |
| `policy/T3` | `must-flag` | 568 |

| Basis change | Fixtures |
| --- | --- |
| T2 recorded as `project-policy`: cited sources do not include two distinct owners | 343 |
| T1 recorded below `provider-documented`: no cited source is provider-owned | 0 |

T0 fixtures were unscored in the legacy benchmark, so they become `not-assertable`. Their candidate spans are kept as non-asserting data (`candidateReading`, `asserting: false`; ADR 0012 decision 2), never as expected spans: 28 spans in 28 fixtures. Evidence in `unresolved` never carries a must-flag or must-not-flag expectation.

Per-fixture family override (ADR 0012 decision 4): 35 fixtures of Cases that span several families carry their own narrower `families` list, which removes 87 family links the Case-level union would otherwise give them. The Cases are unchanged.

## Historical incidents

| Legacy known-gap data | Count |
| --- | --- |
| known-gap issues read | 63 |
| kind `false-negative` | 38 |
| kind `false-positive` | 25 |
| incident attachments on Cases | 7 |

Each issue becomes an `incidents[]` entry on the Case that owns one of its fixtures, or on the fixture itself when the fixture is a matrix cell: a scanner-neutral failure mode (`false-alarm`, `missed-credential`), the issue title as the summary, the date first observed, and the product issue as an `externalRefs` pointer. Product workflow (status, fix commit, promotion, candidate build) and the recorded scanner findings are not imported.

| fixture `detectors` (in corpora) | 4,508 | Same as above. |
| fixture `arrivalTargets` | 1,079 | Product arrival-family scoring targets. |
| `assessment.contract` (detector-keyed contract id) | 5,676 | Detector key; the family and its format contract come from the fixture index instead. |
| fixture `expectedAction` (redact/warn) | 124 | Product policy action, not a semantic outcome. |

| fixture `formatReason` | 58 | Duplicate of `assessment.reason`. |
| fixture-index `provenance.milestone` / `release` | 3,901 / 1,465 | Product release bookkeeping. |
| `assessment.reason` variants collapsed to the most frequent one per evidence entry | 875 | An evidence entry has one reason; the other wordings are per-fixture repetitions (mostly "Negative twin of <fixture>: ..."). |
| first-import case prose of template-worded cases (titles, summaries, rationales) | 1,840 | Generated from role templates plus family names; the reasoning each states is now one Scenario, written once. See the reclassification report. |
| first-import `twin-of` relations between cases | 540 | A property of the legacy groups; the twin groups are scenario cells now. Fixture-level lineage is kept. |
| companion spans on must-not-flag fixtures | 1 | A companion span means "redacting is accepted, never required"; a must-not-flag fixture has no spans in the canonical model. |
| boilerplate span notes | 2,419 | The standard synthetic-value sentence, already implied by the safety rule. |
| assessment sources with no evidence-source record | 68 | Project-owned URLs (`https://github.com/redact-secret/redact-secret/blob/ec9224d9743066fe73d6e61e9843ef52bd853833/docs/decisions/2026-09-24-redact-provider-named-credential-assignments.md`, `https://github.com/redact-secret/redact-secret/issues/948`) that the taxonomy import did not carry. |
| known-gap product workflow: status (`fixed` / `verified` / `policy-decision`) | 35 / 21 / 7 | Product lifecycle, not evidence. |
| known-gap product workflow: fix, promotion, candidate build, verification, disposition | 56 / 56 / 63 / 21 / 7 | Product workflow and release state. |
| known-gap recorded scanner findings (expected vs actual rows) | 194 | Scanner output is an observation for downstream repositories, never evidence. |
| known-gap fixtures in suites outside the imported set | 37 | Fixtures of legacy suites that are not part of this import (`beta9-external-inputs`); 11 issue(s) have no imported fixture and therefore no incident. |

Also not imported: `supportStatus`, scores and ledger rows (never in these files). Free text is truncated to the 2,000-character schema limit when needed: 0 truncation(s).

## Families

160 of 173 taxonomy families are referenced by at least one case or fixture cell. 13 are not: `atlassian:access-token`, `aws:context-specific-credential`, `aws:sts-service-bearer-token`, `google:oauth2-credential`, `linear:oauth-access-token`, `mistral:realtime-client-token`, `netlify:other-prefixed-tokens`, `npm:legacy-token`, `openrouter:management-api-key`, `slack:workflow-webhook-token`, `vercel:api-key`, `vercel:integration-token`, `voyage-ai:api-key`. They have contracts and sources (#3) but no legacy fixture exercised them.

## Determinism and reproduction

The importer runs the legacy generators (`fixtures/generated/build.mjs`) in a child process over the pinned `git archive`, checks each corpus's SHA-256 against `benchmarks/generated-corpora.json`, and refuses to import on any mismatch. Canonical ids, ordering and wording are pure functions of that input, of the committed taxonomy records (#3) and of the authored tables. `npm run migrate:cases:check` regenerates in memory and compares every owned file and the reports.
